brief:
Mondoweiss founder Phil Weiss believes the American Israel Public Affairs Committee has lost its grip on US politics, according to an interview with the outlet he established. Weiss reflected on Mondoweiss's early coverage of the Israel Lobby and said major shifts are occurring in the US-Israel relationship that have diminished AIPAC's traditional power.

The founder discussed the challenges of reporting on pro-Israel advocacy groups and suggested the political landscape has changed substantially since Mondoweiss began documenting the lobby's activities.
dek: Mondoweiss founder Phil Weiss reflects on the early days of Mondoweiss, the challenges of covering the Israel Lobby, and the major shifts happening with the US-Israel relationship.
title: Mondoweiss founder says AIPAC's influence is waning
